results.name: The local API rejects missing authentication, hostile origins and arbitrary actions
The three-screen interface loads locally without external assets
Normal mouse-release clicks keep settings and search fields focused for real keyboard input
Connection drafts survive blur, unrelated job completion and scanner switching
The PDF preview returns the selected verified local report
Approve removes one pending suggestion without names or confirmation dialogs
Undo restores pending and Disapprove keeps the PDF as Other
A stale approval cannot overwrite a later organization decision
Filtering and export use the matching saved PDFs
Saved organization decisions survive a full host restart
Connection failures remain visible and job records do not expose entered passwords
The interface remains usable at a smaller workstation size

scope: Actual local host, PowerShell adapter and synthetic archived PDFs. Does not establish hospital network access or workstation endpoint-policy approval.
